text.description_html:
Dorma RTS88 Concealed Door Closer

Dorma overhead door closer for single and double acting (door opens in both directions) doors. Consistent closure speed is assured every time with its temperature-sensitive hydraulic fluid. Packaged with Front and Back mounting brackets.

This RTS 88 Made by Dorma concealed closer is a light #3 spring closer, for doors up to 36 inches wide and 125 lbs.

Features and Specifications for Dorma RTS88 Closer:

  • High Tensile Steel Camshaft and Pistons
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Maximum Door Size: 36" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 125 lbs
  • Spring Tension: #3 Light
  • Backstop: Optional 90 or 105 degree Swing Back Stop
  • Non Handed (Double Acting - swings both ways)
  • Optional Hold Open or non-Hold Open
  • Packaged with Front and Back mounting brackets.

Sold Individually
